name: The Count of Monte Cristo
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: The Count of Monte Cristo was written by Alexandre Dumas, first published in 1844.
Edmond Dantès is wrongly imprisoned and escapes to enact an elaborate revenge on those who betrayed him -- a sprawling, page-turning adventure classic.
Discussion prompt: Betrayal is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
